text_en: O sing to the Lord a new song; sing to the Lord , all the earth.
text_cn: 请众齐向上主歌唱新歌， 普世大地，请向上主讴歌！

text_en: Sing to the Lord , bless his name; tell of his salvation from day to day.
text_cn: 请向上主歌唱，赞美他的圣名， 一日复一日地，宣扬他的救恩。

text_en: Declare his glory among the nations, his marvelous works among all the peoples.
text_cn: 请在列邦中，传述他的光荣， 请在万民中，宣扬他的奇功。

text_en: For great is the Lord , and greatly to be praised; he is to be revered above all gods.
text_cn: 因为上主伟大，应受赞美， 惟他超越众神，可敬可畏。

text_en: For all the gods of the peoples are idols, but the Lord made the heavens.
text_cn: 万邦的众神尽属虚幻， 但上主却造成了苍天；

text_en: Honor and majesty are before him; strength and beauty are in his sanctuary.
text_cn: 威严与尊荣，常在他的面前， 权能与光耀，围绕他的圣坛。

text_en: Ascribe to the Lord , O families of the peoples, ascribe to the Lord glory and strength.
text_cn: 各民各族，请将光荣归于上主， 各家各户，请将威能归于上主。

text_en: Ascribe to the Lord the glory due his name; bring an offering, and come into his courts.
text_cn: 请将主名的光荣归于上主！ 请进入他的庭院奉献祭物。

text_en: Worship the Lord in holy splendor; tremble before him, all the earth.
text_cn: 请穿圣洁的礼服，叩拜上主， 普世大地，要在他面前颤抖！

text_en: Say among the nations, “The Lord is king! The world is firmly established; it shall never be moved. He will judge the peoples with equity. ”
text_cn: 请在万民中高呼：上主为王！ 他稳定寰宇，使它不再动荡， 他以正义公道来治理万邦。

text_en: Let the heavens be glad, and let the earth rejoice; let the sea roar, and all that fills it;
text_cn: 愿诸天欢乐，愿大地踊跃， 愿海及其中的一切怒号！

text_en: let the field exult, and everything in it. Then shall all the trees of the forest sing for joy
text_cn: 原野及其中的一切都要舞蹈， 森林中的一切树木各显欢乐，

text_en: before the Lord ; for he is coming, for he is coming to judge the earth. He will judge the world with righteousness, and the peoples with his truth.
text_cn: 在上主面前欢乐，因为他已驾临， 因为他已驾临，要统治大地乾坤； 他要以正义审判普世人群， 以他的忠信治理天下万民。
